newsitem.title: USA: Ill. metro areas unemployment below 5 pct in April.
newsitem.headline: Ill. metro areas unemployment below 5 pct in April.

text.p: The unemployment rate in eight of Illinois' 10 metropolitan areas dropped below five percent in April, marking the lowest levels statewide in the 1990s, the Illinois Department of Employment Security announced Thursday.

"Job growth in four key industry sectors contributed to the overall well-being of the state's economy -- services, trade, manufacturing and finance-insurance-real estate," department Director Lynn Doherty said.
The unadjusted rates for all 10 metro areas dropped in April compared to March and were down in all but one area when compared to April 1996, the report said.
The Chicago area rate dropped 0.4 percent to 4.7 percent in April and was down the same percent over April 1996, the report said.
